mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly expansion in real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates strengthening economic fundamentals that boost corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate decline below 0.25% signals aggressive monetary easing that lowers discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC over a 2-year rolling window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.0%), rising retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenues and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.0% and RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC in high-inflation regimes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates manufacturing sector weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over a 1-year window is negative.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing contraction regimes (INDPRO < 95.0), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals deepening economic weakness that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 and HOUST is declining, or the Rank IC in manufacturing contraction regimes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increases in CPIAUCSL indicate monetary policy uncertainty that creates market volatility, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises, or the interaction term in a regression has a positive coefficient with p<0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 800.0 signals cooling housing market conditions that reduce consumer wealth and spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 800.0, or the Rank IC over a 1-year window is negative.
